summary: Kickoff for the current contract year; Aisha set adoption targets for three clinical teams.
Mid-year check-in; adoption at two of three teams, Aisha flagged budget pressure for next year.
Aisha asked for renewal pricing options with a two-year term and a revised SSO security questionnaire.
Short call; Aisha said a new data platform lead is joining and wants to scope a pilot.
Reviewed the business associate agreement; Grace to send redlines on data retention clauses.
Grace said redlines are delayed pending legal review.
Signed the 2026 contract; Marcus pushed hard on uptime commitments.
Escalation about a two-hour outage in the routing dashboard; resolved with a service credit.
Marcus asked for a draft 2027 rate card ahead of renegotiation.
Elena introduced herself as the new procurement lead and requested updated vendor onboarding forms.
Elena said procurement wants a 10% volume discount for 2027.
Met Carlos at an energy analytics conference; interested in grid demand forecasting.
Carlos agreed to an intro call and said he would bring a partnerships colleague.
Weekly pipeline review; Priya asked for Harbourview renewal risk notes.
Daniel shared Kestrel uptime figures for the renegotiation.
Mei Lin circulated the Q1 roadmap and asked for customer feature requests.
